papers.title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
papers.summary: NPCBench evaluates whether medical AI models can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and maintain temporally coherent diagnostic and care decisions across longitudinal nasopharyngeal carcinoma patient pathways.

papers.title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
papers.summary: EDGAR is a conditional diffusion framework with a fusion block and Mixture-of-Experts that refines degraded Gaussian head avatars by injecting self-supervised identity features, using refined multi-view renderings as pseudo-targets to optimize a single avatar.

papers.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
papers.summary: Drex open decision models return probability distributions over user-supplied options without autoregressive decoding, using supervised fine-tuning, RLAF, and consistency losses to improve accuracy, robustness, and latency.

papers.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: D3D is a standalone diffusion drafter that removes target-model hidden-state dependencies to enable asynchronous speculative decoding with high speedup.
